_doc: Config of payoff.py (the three-arm second-GPU payoff comparison). Same schema as scripts/placement-qual/arms.json for vars, engine, arms, variants, limits, so qual_cfg.load and qual_engine.Engine run it unchanged; the sweep, the gates and the estimate are this harness's. {name} placeholders come from vars (override with --var name=value) plus {rundir}. WHY each arm flag is what it is: README.md section Design. Flags this file owns and the launcher's base config must NOT contain: --expert-cache, --expert-cache-device1, --pcie-frac, --resident-budget-gib, --max-context, --short-read, --stats.

vars.gpu: UNSET: pass --var gpu=<CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES for the second card: an index or a GPU UUID; a UUID identifies one machine, so it is never kept in the repo>
vars.rocm: UNSET: pass --var rocm=<the ROCm install dir>
vars.pack: UNSET: pass --var pack=<the model pack dir>

A.label: local RAM experts
A.note: one GPU; every expert the cache lacks is computed by the CPU pool where it sits in RAM (Strata default for a weak link)

B.label: host weights transferred
B.note: one GPU; every expert the cache lacks is copied over PCIe and computed on the GPU. The log is checked to prove the share took effect (gates.b_pcie_min_share)

C.label: second GPU holds experts
C.note: the seabraid helper holds what the main cache lacks (static placement); --pcie-frac 0 so what is left over is CPU-computed exactly as in A, which makes A-vs-C differ by the helper alone

sweep.caps_note: ESTIMATE for IQ2_XS on an R9700 32 GB main: 11000 (fits on main) and 4000 (heavy overflow) are the measured rows in compat/strata/README.md; 8000, 6000 and 2500 are spread points. The slot count the engine really logs is what the analysis uses.

estimate.note: ESTIMATE: none of these were measured by this harness; they bound the GPU window so the maintainers can book it. Decode tok/s 20..105 spans heavy-overflow stock (README: 52-60 at cap 4000, hangs seen) to all-in-VRAM (105); prefill 150..1500 tok/s and the engine load are guesses; replace them with the first live run's chain.tsv.
